description:
Tale of siblings abandoned by mother in famine. Eating
mushrooms the two hallucinate a house made of cake.
name: Fairy-tale【Hansel&Gretel】

description:
The monster the three pigs raised escaped and devoured
them. Hyena of hunger settled in the destroyed ranch.
name: Fairy-tale【Three Little Pigs】

description:
There was a king clad in an impregnable iron armor.
But being a hindrance for lust, the armor was unseen.
name: Fairy-tale【King's New Clothes】

description:
Meow-meow-meow, we're strong.
Meow-meow-meow, we're knight.
name: Fairy-tale【Knight in Armor】

description:
Faithful dog protected beloved owner. From beasts.
From disease. And so it was sacrificed by fools.
name: Fairy-tale【Dog of Elixir】

description:
♪You are blowing your horn with one of my bones. My brother
slew me, and gained the princess by pretending 'twas he.
name: Fairy-tale【Singing Bone】

description:
Persecuted for poverty and exiled, the man got revenge
by leading rats to spread disease, destroying the city.
name: Fairy-tale【Pied Piper of Elixir】

description:
Abused, animals swear to take revenge on humans. The
music they play is violent, ghastly, and yet artistic.
name: Fairy-tale【Musicians of Bremen】

description:
This duck had a family. But the war took everything from him,
leaving only bloodlust. Now, he only seeks more conflict.
name: Fairy-tale【Ugly Duckling】

description:
Poor boy was abandoned by his mother with some beans.
Starving, he ate them and grew huge in a blink of an eye.
name: Fairy-tale【Jack and Beanstalk】

description:
Peter Pan will come for kids who stay up late. Forever
he'll lock them in his prison. Even now he may be outside…
name: Fairy-tale【Peter Pan】

description:
For thousand nights Sinbad sailed through the seven seas.
His humanity is gone, yet his adventures will continue.
name: Fairy-tale【Adventures of Sinbad】

description:
Demon said 「I'll grant any one your desires」.
And Alladin replied 「Then hand over your power」.
name: Fairy-tale【Alladin and Wonderful Lamp】

description:
With the truth exposed, the king rages. Consigning servants
and people to death, he soon brings ruin to the country.
name: Fairy-tale【King with Donkey Ears】

description:
Do not release him, for he is a weapon of slaughter.
And yet the ignorance prince set free the Iron Hans.
name: Fairy-tale【Iron Hans】

description:
Using the beast, the beauty obtained fortune and station.
The beast yearned for her love, no matter how fake.
name: Fairy-tale【Beauty and Beast】

description:
Two insane knights. Comrades in timeless rivalry.
「Let us compete. Who will kill, rape, and cheat more?」
name: Fairy-tale 【Tortoise and Hare】

description:
Mother said. This Match will show a wonderful dream.
How you make it? With the flesh of women from here…….
name: Fairy-tale【Little Match Girl】

description:
Alice noticed it. This wonderful world is fake.
All nothing more than a wild delusion……even I.
name: Fairy-tale【Alice in Wonderland】

description:
With three servants I've killed countless witches.
Soon enough I'll be the greatest wizard of all.
name: Fairy-tale【Wizard of Oz】

description:
Why people war? Why is humanity so ugly? I cannot
believe in God anymore. So thought witch in the fire.
name: Fairy-tale 【Jeanne d'Arc】

description:
That bird can give an ordinary man vast riches.
That bird will suddenly get bored and fly away.
name: Fairy-tale【Golden Goose】

description:
From the deepest faith comes doubt in God's existence.
The world has come to this, is where God in it?
name: Fairy-tale【Saint of Alexandria】

description:
Human structure can be improved. Nature is imperfect.
So muttered Pinocchio, dissecting yet another corpse.
name: Fairy-tale【Pinocchio】

description:
Girl with a charming golden hair rules minds and bodies.
Entranced, many men submit to her, building a kingdom.
name: Fairy-tale【Rapunzel】

description:
The prince dropped his shoe into a bog. Huge toad jumped
out and kissed him, killed him. Ah…and he was my prince.
name: Fairy-tale【Princess Frog】

description:
The mermaid fell in love with the prince. Unrequited,
that love soon consumed the prince's country in a tsunami.
name: Fairy-tale【Little Mermaid】

description:
Jealous of beauty, queen stepmother tried to kill
Snow White. And she did the same, wanting the same.
name: Fairy-tale【Snow White】

description:
Ash-clad princess invites dreaming women to a ball.
And in exchange for dreams she takes their souls…….
name: Fairy-tale【Cinderella】

description:
Tyrannic queen had a hobby of torturing servants and
daughters of nobles. Her favorite was 「Iron Maiden」.
name: Fairy-tale【Queen Elisabeth】

description:
One day the wind fought with the sun. For three days
and nights typhoons and blazes ruined the land.
name: Fairy-tale【North Wind and Sun】

description:
Smeared in blood*****hood***created****wolf********
****fantasy*******what number does that make her***
name: Fairy-tale【Little Red Riding Hood】
